svg.title: Climate Value Framework
svg.desc: Five questions viewed through an enterprise value lens: three diagnose exposure (value today, climate influences, your evidence) and two decide action (financial impact, best responses), with board oversight across all five, repeated as a cycle. Copyright Susan McHattie, used under licence by Sightlines Advisory.

g.text: Five questions, one lens: what climate means for enterprise value
Decide — act on what matters most
Board oversight across all five — govern, monitor, report
The outcome: a foundation for sustaining company performance — not just disclosure
↻ What the board monitors becomes the starting point for the next cycle
